title: DOJ files civil action to forfeit over $1.1 billion in USDC tied to North Korean theft from Binance
date_note: The DOJ release is dated 23 November 2026 and gives no earlier day for the filing.
geo_basis: the federal court in Washington, DC, as Cointelegraph states
summary: The Justice Department release says it filed a civil claim to forfeit over $1.1 billion of USDC that it says are proceeds of a theft from Binance on or about Oct. 29 by North Korean cyber actors. It says the government is helping Binance recover over $6 billion in stolen assets. Fox Business reported more than $1 billion; Cointelegraph reported more than $1.1 billion.
plain: The US Justice Department says it filed a claim to take over $1.1 billion of USDC that it says came from a theft from Binance on or about Oct. 29 by North Korean cyber actors.
exec: The Justice Department says it filed to forfeit over $1.1 billion of USDC it ties to the Binance theft, and says it is helping Binance recover over $6 billion in stolen assets.

evidence.quote: The U.S. government has begun legal proceedings to recover more than $1 billion in cryptocurrency
held across 36 virtual currency addresses spanning 18 different blockchain networks
The US Department of Justice is seeking to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto
prosecutors asked a federal court in Washington, DC, to permanently forfeit the funds

validation.note: DOJ release (primary) read; Fox Business (more than $1 billion) and Cointelegraph (more than $1.1 billion) also report it. The DOJ gives over $1.1 billion.
